title: HeyGen Frame.md: Teach AI to Code Branded Videos in Seconds
description:
AI agents are butchering your brand in videos because they treat 16:9 frames like webpages. HeyGen just changed the game with Hyperframes and frame.md.

In this short, learn how turning your design.md into frame.md teaches AI the exact pacing, scale, and motion needed to generate perfectly branded videos automatically.

#HeyGen #Hyperframes #AIVideo #ClaudeCode #AgenticAI #MotionGraphics #WebDev
